say.text: Isa went first to Sayf ad-Din Ali, called al-Mashtub, and won him over.
The jurist. Have you come to tell me to bend my knee to a young man with no troops?
That high place will never be yours, as long as al-Yaruqi and Ibn Talil live.
Hm. So the question is not whether I bow, but to whom. And which of them leaves me my castles.
The one who has nothing yet to take from you. Think of what you will have if he keeps his place.
